name: Colormind · Colormind

description.zh: 把色板和下方仪表盘对照，模板文件还需从原作者处取得。 生成颜色组合并提供网页、仪表盘模板配色预览的在线工具，支持指定或锁定起始颜色。官方 API 明确仅个人与非商业用途免费，商业应用需联系；网站使用价格和输出授权未确认，模板本身按原作者条款处理。
description.en: An online palette generator with website and dashboard color previews and controls for selecting or locking starting colors. The official API is free only for personal and non-commercial use; commercial applications require contact. Website pricing and output permissions remain unverified, and templates retain their authors’ terms.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Colormind (https://colormind.io/).
Technology stack: css.
Component specification: 把色板和下方仪表盘对照，模板文件还需从原作者处取得。

Visual details from source observation: 我们在首页看到色块、色值和锁定控件，先保留一个起始颜色，更容易比较后续生成的组合。建议打开 Website Colors 看五种颜色怎样分给底色、强调色和品牌色，再到 Paper Dashboard 对照侧栏与统计卡片；两页提供不同模板的配色预览。API 仅声明个人与非商业用途免费，商业调用需联系作者，网页生成结果的授权仍未确认。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
